plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 Major Map (recommended sequence) for the B.S. in Hospitality Management, College of Hospitality, Retail, and Sport Management, School of Hospitality and Tourism Management, from the USC Major Map Repository (2026_hosp-mgmt_map.pdf). 8 semesters plus a required 6-credit summer internship (HTMT 495, 400 hours) after junior year, transcribed as its own term. Semester sums verified against printed totals (16/16/15/15/13/12/6/15/12 at slot minimums = 120, matches Graduation Requirements Summary: 120 total, 51 major, 27-39 college/program, 31-43 Carolina Core, 2.00 GPA). Ranged slots transcribed at minimums with notes: Carolina Core ARP (3-4) at 3; Foreign Language/other CC (3-4) at 3; Carolina Core Req (3-4) at 3. HTMT Electives chosen with advisor (at least 6 hours from HTMT); foreign language proficiency (placement 2+, or 109+110, or 121) required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
